mapper.select: SELECT ct.ctid, ct.term, c.cid, c.cname, c.ccredit, t.tid, t.tname, sct.grade FROM student_course_teacher sct JOIN course_teacher ct ON sct.ctid = ct.ctid JOIN course c ON ct.cid = c.cid JOIN teacher t ON ct.tid = t.tid WHERE sct.sid = #{sid} AND ct.term = #{term} AND sct.deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT term FROM course_teacher WHERE deleted = 0
